tools.description: Returns API usage and currently available tools.
Reads and modifies warehouse orders. This tool is fully implemented.

params.title: required order title
params.creatorID: required existing ID of the user creating the order
params.destination: required numeric code of the target city
params.signature: required correct signature for creatorID and destination

notes: New orders start with an empty items list.
creatorID must point to an existing user.
destination must point to one of the valid city destination codes.
signature must match for that creator.

params.name: required item name in single mode
params.items: single quantity OR batch object/array of items

notes: If the item already exists, quantity is increased.
Batch mode accepts {"woda":5,"kilof":7} or [{"name":"woda","items":5},{"name":"kilof","items":7}].
Deletes the whole order.

tools.description: Generates signatures for provided user and destination

params.birthday: required birthday in YYYY-MM-DD existing for user mentioned in login
params.destination: required numeric destination ID of the target city

tools.description: Validates whether one order fully satisfies all city needs and returns the flag on success.
Restores the current user state to the initial set of seeded orders.
Read-only access to the SQLite database used by the task.
